text:
maya: taking night primary tonight 22:00-06:00 UTC (root). jon is secondary. quick context: we're still seeing intermittent embedding queue latency spikes (inc-457), customer impact limited to search/related embeddings timing out ~2-5s extra but some retries causing user-facing errors. there's a frontend deploy at 23:30 UTC that historically causes alert noise; i've pre-armed both pages for +1h around the deploy. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-queue

incident-bot: ALERT SUMMARY - 21:47 UTC - embedding-queue-high-latency (inc-457) - 17 alerts in 10m, median p95 latency 1.8s -> 3.6s. Top offenders: inf-03, inf-07. No 500s observed. (reacted with :eyes:)

jon: ack. i'll be reachable by phone and slack. i have a calendar overlap 02:00-03:00 UTC (all-hands prep) — if we need continuous coverage for that hour i can swap secondary or shadow. maya, want me to take primary 02:00-06:00 and you take 22:00-02:00?

maya: i can do 22:00-02:00 and then hand off to you at 02:00 if you want. alternate: sam offered to backfill a short gap earlier. my preference is a clean 4h/4h split, but i can cover whole night if swap is hairy.

sam: i can take 01:45-03:15 as short cover for the all-hands if that helps. phone +1-555-0123. happy to be secondary for that window.

leah: FYI if embedding lag spikes, cheap first-step mitigation is to restart the slow worker on inf-03; it clears stuck KV cache around 5-10s. steps below (from runbook snippet). use with caution during deploy due to cache warmup.

leah: ```
# restart worker on inf-03
ssh ops@inf-03
sudo systemctl restart redwood-embed-worker
# confirm queue drain
curl -s http://inf-03:9100/metrics | grep embeddings_queue_length
```

maya: noted. i'll avoid restarts during 23:25-23:45 (deploy window) unless p50->p95 jumps > 2x. also: escalation policy reminder — primary should ack and start triage within 10m; if unacked for 15m pagerduty escalates to secondary, then to oncall manager after 30m. pd runbook link: https://redwood.internal/pd/escalation

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: suppression rule applied for deploy noise from 23:20-23:50 UTC (rule id: sup-22deploy). Alerts will still appear but will not escalate.

jon: thanks — sounds good. if i take 02:00-06:00 primary, i can be on standby for a 10m shadow handoff at 01:55. maya, want me to post "i'm primary now" at 02:00 here and update rotation in the schedule?

maya: yes please. i'll post the handoff timestamp and a short summary at 01:55 and then again at 02:00. handoff checklist: current incidents, any in-progress mitigations, pods/nodes in degraded state, scheduled deploys, phone numbers. short checklist copied below.

maya: Handoff checklist excerpt:
- active incidents: inc-457 (embedding latency) - mitigation: monitor, restart inf-03 if needed outside deploy window.
- scheduled deploys: frontend 23:30 (suppression active).
- machines to watch: inf-03 (heavy kv churn), inf-07 (memory bump).
- metrics to watch: embeddings_p95, embeddings_error_rate, embeddings_queue_length.
- quick commands: `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep embed` and the restart steps in runbook.

sam: I can confirm coverage 01:45-03:15, will jump in if pages come to me.

incident-bot: NOTE - 22:10 UTC - new warning: embeddings_p95 crossing 2s threshold on inf-07. No user 500s yet. Logged to inc-457.

maya: cool. final ask: whoever becomes primary at 02:00, please update the oncall rota (internal schedule) and ping #oncall-ops with "primary: <name>" so downstream teams know. i'll start the handoff thread at 01:55 with a short state summary. thanks all. :pray:

jon: will do. posting handoff at 01:55 and taking primary at 02:00. good luck! :thumbsup:
